Timing correction
ON captures phase_request_started after prompt/context/token admission and
immediately before begin_gen. ON r0 uses that captured value. Thus the previous
GEN's quiescence/graph retirement/invalidate/unmap/drain/reinit enter this GEN's
prompt_ms. OFF still takes Clock::now at the original r0 location.
Removed the timestamp before successful_prompt. prompt_ms now takes Clock::now
at its original final reporting position, after successful_prompt finishes
retirement/reset/map/fill/readback/compare/publication/host refresh and its logs.
Decode start placement is unchanged. First GEN has no previous-GEN treatment.
Warm-up is charged by the identical cycle. Startup/base fill, admission before
r0, decode and QUIT are outside prompt_ms. PrefillStats compute aggregation is
unchanged and remains separately recorded before reset.

Accounting implementation
Small owner Timings counters and PhaseTimedCall use std::chrono::steady_clock.
Counter fields: calls, succeeded, attempted bytes, successful bytes, elapsed ns.
Destructor commits each completed attempted span; result(bool) marks success.
Failed/throwing scoped operations retain a failed attempt and elapsed span.
Owner snapshots copied immediately before begin_gen/successful_prompt; deltas
are emitted before phase_fatal on a returned failure. Error strings and poisoned
state still use existing failure paths. No expected 768/1536 copy counts are
substituted for successful actual operations.

Native reserve/physical/attach/detach/destroy/drain/release are separately timed.
Native map/unmap count only backend calls actually attempted; no-handle detach
is not counted as a successful unmap. Byte totals for map/physical operations
use actual extent bytes, not payload or nominal slot count. Uncertain ownership
and checked drain/delete order are preserved. A private drain wrapper adds the
counter around the same backend drain call, without additional callbacks.
Expert fill H2D, D2H and memcmp use actual bytes passed and actual results.
D2H remains skipped after failed H2D; comparison remains skipped after either
failed copy. Successful comparison still precedes filled/staged state changes.
Residency-table H2D/D2H/compare have separate counters, also preserving checked
copy/readback/compare order. Failed reads/writes do not accrue successful bytes.
Publication and invalidation include their original nested validation/callback/
drain spans; they are not transfer-only metrics.

Cycle operation/transition logs distinguish begin_gen, successful_prompt,
complete_gen, quiesce, graph_retire, retire_workspace, grow_fill_publish,
invalidate_detach and reinit_workspace. Prefill reset has its own returned-call
span. QUIT quiesce/reset/graph retirement are separately recorded; checked close
prints owner close/unmap/destroy/drain/release deltas before destruction or failure.
Successful startup baseline publication prints cumulative owner counters from a
zero snapshot. Early startup failures before this publication keep original
fatal errors; there is no claimed completed startup summary for those failures.
Cycle failure logs name attempted operation and failure status; the existing
phase_fatal error preserves the reason. Hard process termination cannot unwind
an outer QUIT scope; its already-completed operation/checked-close logs remain.

host_elapsed_ms/nested=1 explicitly mark overlapping/nested host spans. Their
sum is NOT wall time. Copy spans include backend selection/enqueue/synchronous
wait; they do not measure GPU event duration or transfer-only device time.
Existing combined fill_check_ms label is renamed grow_fill_publish_ms because
it includes map, copies, comparison, publication, refresh and mapping logs.
Mapped/capacity numbers in growth and invalidation logs now come from actual
owner values, while original admission equality checks remain unchanged.
The whole prompt_ms also includes diagnostic logging overhead; measure rather
than infer whether that overhead matters. No per-fill printing was added.

Preservation
No owner is constructed with ordinary OFF, so new owner accounting has no OFF
fill/decode hot-path clocks or counters. Cycle timing runs only when phase cycle
methods are actually invoked. No change to GPU queue ordering, checked waits,
quiescence callbacks, ownership lifetime, failed poisoning, graph retirement,
slot geometry, close/free protocol, readback requirement or publication order.
The 512MiB guard, +16/layer, 8192 chunk, stock omitted-ckpt1 actual-no-reuse
admission, no-MTP guard, quantization/precision and session buffers are retained.
No prefill/GEMM math, VMM granularity policy, batch or UI/options were changed.
Full262144 remains unverified; this is instrumentation, not qualification.

Main checks — NONE executed here
1. Close measurement 16177 and serialize every following check/build/GPU run.
   Review W source against v4 report plus this file. Include new phase_timing.hpp
   in the source closure. Main owns source/environment/samples/results/decisions
   retention and the next committed report boundary; old receipts do not transfer.
2. Follow v4 host phase_cache_owner_test build, CTest, NDEBUG and ASan/UBSan
   recipes. Existing actual lifetime/fault fixtures must retain their outcomes.
   Inspect stdout/stderr separately: new diagnostic records must not alter
   command protocol. Build/lint free and contrib-llvm with the qualified compiler
   recipes and actual compile databases; no contrib-icpx substitute.
3. Run v4 server lifetime tests and exclusive tiny actual-VMM fixture; skip 77
   is not PASS. Then exact OFF/ON startup, normal QUIT, debug32K two fresh GENs,
   omitted ckpt then ckpt0, short warm-up then long GEN in the same process.
   Preserve graph/session/slot/readback/host-device residency fault checks.
4. In successful_prompt deltas verify H2D/D2H/memcmp successful call counts and
   bytes against actually filled rank pairs and layer blob sizes. For unchanged
   48*16 fills a clean call outcome should give 768 payload calls in each direction
   and 16*sum(actual blob_bytes) successful bytes in each direction/comparison.
   This is a check expectation, never a logged substitute. Residency-table calls
   and bytes must remain separate. Map counts/bytes must match actual extents.
   In second begin_gen check actual invalidation table copies, successful detach,
   physical deletion, drains and workspace reinit; failed calls must retain counts
   and fail-stop without continuing/restarting the engine.
5. Confirm prompt_ms spans begin_gen and successful_prompt, while PrefillStats
   remains compute-only and OFF uses the previous clock. Compare request wall,
   prompt_ms and decode_ms separately; do not sum nested operation elapsed spans.
   Check QUIT accounting and successful checked release, failure preservation,
   and diagnostic overhead. NVIDIA/smaller device/provider behavior stays unverified.
6. Only after v4 correctness/provider gates, run the unchanged upstream
   bench.sh --long --runs 3 for matched OFF/ON arms on new pinned binaries/configs.
   Do not edit upstream bench.sh/client or existing configs/receipts. Record each
   sample, complete suite order/warm-up, process identity, actual request settings,
   phase transfer/count/bytes/timing and end-to-end wall. Quality comparison uses
   Main's declared fixed-history/logits methodology; text identity is not assumed.

No performance improvement, numerical PASS, compile success or provider safety
is claimed. All tests/lints/builds/runtime/performance and Full262144 remain
unverified. Resume from this report and the source, not a separate backup.
